name: Daumier: Lila & Ghost
summary:
Seen Daumier at **VRGS**?  Join our Discord for the **free Alpha Test in July**: https://discord.gg/QJ228xwDhW

Lila’s family has guarded a secret for centuries. Revealed on her 24th birthday through a letter, it changed her life and left her with one purpose: uncover the truth and set a restless soul free.

Drawn to the Daumier Art Gallery tied to her family’s history, Lila soon realizes she is not alone. As she reaches toward a painting, she feels a presence. Ghost has been waiting.
